subject: Expansion: Additional apps & API keys for Q1 rollout
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-01-10T10:02:00-05:00
Subject: Expansion of Redwood services to 3 additional product teams

Hi Sofia,

Following our renewal discussion earlier this week, the product org wants to onboard three more internal applications onto Redwood for Q1. High level: two consumer-facing apps (chat & summarization) and one back-office classifier. We anticipate staggered rollouts over six weeks and would need separate API keys and basic usage segregation per app.

Can you confirm:
- Whether we can add new API keys under the existing contract or if an amendment is required
- Time to provision keys and any lead times for capacity increases
- Any pricing/term implications for adding three apps (est. combined peak RPS ~120)

Cc'ing procurement for PO/timeline visibility. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Zhou
Director, Product Integrations
Acme Health
---
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-01-10T14:38:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Expansion of Redwood services to 3 additional product teams

Emily — thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front:

- Keys & contract: We can provide per-app API keys under your existing account. Adding dedicated quotas and separate key-level billing will require a short amendment to the SOW (one page).
- Provisioning lead time: Standard provisioning for up to 5 additional keys is 24–48 hours once we have the admin contacts and key names. If you need increased capacity beyond current committed throughput we'll queue a capacity bump (lead time depends on the size; for +120 peak RPS we estimate a 5–7 business day window to validate and scale Dedicated pools).
- Pricing: If the expansion increases committed units we generally route through a lightweight amendment (no change to base term unless you want additional committed capacity). I can propose a one-off Q1 ramp discount if you commit to a +12 month extension on the added capacity.

I've attached an API-key-request-template.csv to capture the app names, owners, and initial quota expectations — please fill that and return. I'll draft an amendment and send the SOW + DocuSign link for approval once we have your inputs.

Proposed next steps:
1) You send completed template with app names & estimated monthly tokens by Friday (2027-01-14).
2) We produce an amendment for signing (target same-week turnaround).
3) Keys provisioned within 48 hours of signed amendment; capacity scale validated in the following 5–7 business days.

If procurement prefers, we can also push a change to billing milestones (invoice vs PO) — include PO# when you return the template.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
Attachments: API-key-request-template.csv
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-11T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Expansion of Redwood services to 3 additional product teams

Internal — forwarding Emily's ask. Drafting an amendment & SOW; thinking of proposing: +3 app keys, estimated addl committed throughput of 50k tokens/day (~+120 peak RPS), 12-month term on new capacity to lock discount.

Attached: initial Amendment-Q1-Expansion-draft.pdf (placeholder), plus the API-key CSV template I already sent.

Questions for pricing:
- Recommended commercial for mid-market account in healthcare: 10% ramp discount vs list for first 3 months? Or prefer flat per-token credit?
- Any compliance gating for additional subteams that we should note (they mentioned consumer-facing chat — might need a separate data handling note).

I'll plan to send the external SOW + DocuSign this afternoon once we sync.

— Sofia
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-11T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Expansion of Redwood services to 3 additional product teams

Sofia — good plan. Recommend the following commercial motion:

- Offer a time-limited onboarding credit equal to 8% of estimated incremental spend for Q1 to smooth ramp (credit applied to first two invoices).
- Require a 12-month commitment on the increased committed throughput to keep unit pricing stable.
- No change to core SLAs; include a short paragraph in the amendment that we will monitor model quality regressions for consumer-facing chat and trigger a follow-up if we see anomalous request patterns.

Compliance note: Ask Acme to confirm whether any PHI will traverse these endpoints. If PHI is involved we'll need to trigger the security/compliance intake (SOC2 evidence + data flow diagram). That will add ~3 business days to onboarding.

I'll update the amendment with the credit language and a billing milestone for the PO#. Rishi — can you confirm capacity lead time numbers (5–7 bd) and whether we can prioritize the consumer chat app in the queue?

-Neha
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T09:41:00-05:00
Subject: Amendment & SOW for Q1 app expansion — DocuSign link included

Emily / procurement team — attaching the amendment and a short SOW for the three-app expansion. Key points:
- Adds up to 5 new API keys (you requested 3) with optional per-key quota controls.
- Proposed 12-month commitment on the added throughput to qualify for the onboarding credit (8% applied to estimated incremental Q1 spend).
- Provisioning timeline: keys provided within 48 hours of signed amendment; capacity validation 5–7 business days (we can prioritize the consumer chat app if you confirm).

Attachments: Amendment-Q1-Expansion-draft.pdf, API-key-request-template.csv
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/amp/ABC12345 (DocuSign link — amendment for signature)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/RDW-2027-0112-ACM

1) Return the completed CSV with app names & owners (template fields: app_name, owner_email, desired_quota).
2) Procurement to upload PO or complete DocuSign with PO# field populated.
3) Once signed, we'll provision keys and confirm capacity schedule.

If you prefer a short call to lock the timeline I have availability 2027-01-12 11:00–13:00 EST.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Amendment-Q1-Expansion-draft.pdf, API-key-request-template.csv

Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear steps. Two small asks before we sign:
1) Can we shift the billing milestone for the added committed capacity to the start of the second invoice period instead of immediate billing upon signature? That helps align with our internal budget cycle.
2) Please add a PO# field to the DocuSign packet (we will supply PO# ACME-PO-7721).

Emily will consolidate the app owner list and send the completed CSV by Friday (2027-01-14). Once we receive a revised DocuSign with the billing milestone change, procurement will review for signature.

– Thomas
